title: AI Model Releases by Lab
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: AI Capability Tracking
description: Horizontal bar leaderboard of total major AI model releases per lab since November 2022.

learningObjectives: Interpret a ranked horizontal bar chart
Recognize the limitations of release count as a leadership proxy

keyQuestions: Which lab has shipped the most major models since November 2022?
What does release count NOT tell you about a lab's competitiveness?
commonMisconceptions: Equating release count with capability leadership or model quality
assessmentOpportunities: Ask learners to propose a complementary metric to release count

dataSource.name: AI Release Tracker
dataSource.note: Chart values live in ../ai-release-data/data.json, shared with five other MicroSims.
